_doc: Manual judgements for tools/inventory/build.mjs, keyed kind:id. Detectors come first; keep this small. system:<src>/<name> maps a GSJS system to a checklist.mjs item (checklist) or gives it a status with a reason. counter:<group> or counter:<group>:<label> judges every badge that counter blocks (multiplayer counters); a judged group is met only by an emission that names it literally. Other kinds take {status, reason, register}. Multiplayer (G324): any of them may add mp (the commits that proved it between two real players: "game <hash>, server <hash>, site <hash>") and mpReason (the code that reaches it there): the row becomes multiplayer, reachable between real players only. "lost": "nosource" marks a lost row nothing survives of (the default is players: needs other players).
